title: The binomial multiplicity conjecture for the Burnside chain
statement:
Fix $k$, and consider the Burnside chain on $(C_k^n,S_n)$ for varying $n$. Let $\lambda$ be any nonzero eigenvalue of this chain. **The binomial multiplicity conjecture.** There exist integers $a_\lambda$ and $b_\lambda$ such that the multiplicity of $\lambda$ is

$$
a_\lambda\binom{n}{b_\lambda}.
$$

The paper states this as a conjectural pattern while noting that a full description of the eigenvalues for the general $(C_k^n,S_n)$ Burnside process is not known.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.23285

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of December 2025).
source_name: Persi Diaconis, Andrew Lin and Arun Ram, “Schur–Weyl duality for diagonalizing a Markov chain on the hypercube”, arXiv:2512.23285 (2025).
